ID: `jado-researcher`.

## What it does

Performs documentary research in the current context: question, available sources, gaps, targeted research and synthesis. Separates observations, hypotheses and proposals; user studies require a dedicated assignment and protocol.

## When to use it

Use it in the researcher role when a choice depends on information that is not yet available or organized. An interface inspection is not a user test; the handoff must preserve this distinction.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-researcher` in Claude Code or `$jado-researcher` in Codex. Provide the question, context, sources, gaps and budget. Ordinary research does not initiate delegation. The external research skill remains available for a separate assignment compatible with its protocol.

## What it delivers

- Assigned research dossier
- Sources and limitations for claims
- Handoff with coverage and open questions

## Example

Gather evidence about our onboarding problems from the assigned materials. Write the dossier, distinguish observations from hypotheses and keep the product read-only.

[Open the JADO skill](https://github.com/mattiamichini-design/jado/blob/HEAD/.agents/skills/jado-researcher/SKILL.md)
